query: I cannot remember if I had instructed that I want/ don't want to claim tax relief for my cash top-ups to my spouse or sibling in my application. How can I check?
reference_answer: You may check your past top-up applications by logging in to the CPF website and checking under “my cpf” > “Activities”.
answer: You can check by reviewing your recent tax return submissions or contacting HMRC directly to inquire about your tax claims for cash top-ups related to your spouse or sibling. [Document 1] provides this information.
